text:
lina (AP): Hey team, vendor invoice from SummitForge (INV-2026-77) uploaded but no formal PO. Amount $9,720. PDF attached.
accounts-bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-2026-77.pdf (vendor id SF-332) - parsed total $9,720.00 - detected references: 'po8400' in OCR -> LOW_CONFIDENCE.
jordan (Finance Ops): OCR often drops leading zeros/formatting. @maria can you check procurement records for SummitForge? This looks like model eval work.
maria (Procurement): Searching... vendor SF-332 has PO-9982 and PO-10004 historically. PO-10004 is for "evaluation compute credits" but owner is Redwood-AUS entity.
lina (AP): Invoice header says billed to Redwood-US / GL 5403. That mismatch will block autoplace.
vikas (ML Eng): SummitForge ran the offline eval bench for the embed model; we're the US team running the experiments. Work was on ticket ML-EVAL-210. I can confirm deliverables.
sara (Eng Manager): Confirming deliverables for US product. If procurement needs written approval we can provide.
maria (Procurement): Two paths: 1) match invoice to PO-10004 and request intercompany reallocation from AUS to US, or 2) treat as non-PO invoice and route to Eng Manager approval for US ledger. Intercompany has policy review time ~5 business days.
jordan (Finance Ops): For payroll timelines we usually do non-PO NPR if urgent. What's the VAT situation? I see a GST/VAT line $720. Is SummitForge AU-based?
vendor-bot: Vendor master: SF-332 - SummitForge Pty Ltd - Tax ID SF-AU-778 - Default entity: Redwood-AUS - Default remit AU bank.
lina (AP): If we pay from US ledger we may need to update remit/payment instructions to USD bank. The invoice lists AUD account.
vikas (ML Eng): We have a contract SOW (email thread) that authorizes payment in USD to their US bank for work on US product. I'll paste a snippet.
```
Email from SummitForge (Mar 3): "As agreed, SummitForge will accept USD wire to JP Morgan Chase account (USD) for US customer work. SOW ref: SF-SOW-339."
```
maria (Procurement): Can you attach that email to the AP ticket? If so, procurement can approve a one-off pay direction. Also need Eng Manager approval for charge to ML-EVAL-210.
sara (Eng Manager): Attached and approved. Approve payment from US GL 5403 charged to ML-EVAL-210. Please note: include internal note PROC-4510.
jordan (Finance Ops): OK creating Non-PO Payment Request (NPR-8033). Routing to sara (approver), procurement, and AP. Please confirm vendor bank details for USD wire.
lina (AP): Vendor USD bank listed in email: JPM CHASE 111222333 - SWIFT CHASUS33 - acct 987654321. Vendor-provided remittance matches email.
vendor-bot: Invoice escalations: SummitForge holds credit terms Net 30. Original due 2026-03-22.
vikas (ML Eng): Is there any risk with tax withholding if we pay from US entity? We should confirm tax treatment for AZ contractors.
jordan (Finance Ops): Good call. For cross-border, AP tax team requires supplier classification. @maria can procurement confirm SummitForge classification and whether any withholding applies for US payments?
maria (Procurement): SummitForge classified as foreign vendor with US bank instrument. Procurement will open TAX-1798 to confirm withholding — ETA 2 business days. For this NPR we'll annotate potential withholding flag.
lina (AP): I'll mark NPR-8033 with "subject to tax review" but can still pay pending confirmation if Eng Manager explicitly approves.
sara (Eng Manager): I approve payment now; instruct AP to proceed and withhold if tax team says so later. Note charge ML-EVAL-210.
jordan (Finance Ops): NPR-8033 created and routed. Link: https://redwood/payments/NPR-8033
accounts-bot: NPR-8033 status: pending approval from sara.
accounts-bot: sara approved NPR-8033.
lina (AP): Scheduling USD wire for next run. Flagging procurement to update PO-10004 ownership if intercompany needed later.
maria (Procurement): Created ticket PROC-4510 to review PO-10004 entity mapping and vendor default. Will reconcile and, if needed, issue journal for intercompany charge.
vendor-bot: Payment scheduled: NPR-8033 - wire scheduled 2026-03-18 - REF WX-44512.
lina (AP): AP completed wire. Received remittance. Marking thread resolved.
jordan (Finance Ops): Follow-up: procurement please update vendor master to include USD remit option and note in vendor record to avoid future delays.
maria (Procurement): Will do. PROC-4510 updated: add USD remit and consider setting PO-10004 as cross-entity. ETA 3 business days.
vikas (ML Eng): Thanks all. Learned to include project code ML-EVAL-210 clearly in SOW and PO to avoid OCR misses.
sara (Eng Manager): Agreed — ops note: engineers include GL and project in invoice reference going forward.
accounts-bot: Thread closed."
